export declare const SEARCH_FRAGMENT_CHOICES: readonly FragmentOfferChoice[];

export declare const SEARCH_MANAGE_PERMISSION = "search:manage";

export declare const SEARCH_PERMISSIONS: readonly ["search:read", "search:manage"];

export declare const SEARCH_PROVIDER_ID = "system.search";

export declare const SEARCH_READ_PERMISSION = "search:read";

export interface SearchHit {
    hit_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    project_id: string | null;
    plugin_id: string;
    plugin_title: string;
    source: {
        capability_id: string;
        version: number;
        provider_id: string;
    };
    title: string;
    snippet: string;
    highlights: Array<[number, number]>;
    revision: string;
    updated_at: string | null;
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
    locator: {
        field: SearchHitField;
        offset: number;
        length: number;
        text: string;
    };
}

export type SearchHitField = "title" | "summary" | "content";

export interface SearchIndexDocument {
    source_key: string;
    kind: string;
    object_id: string;
    project_id: string | null;
    revision: string;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    content: string;
    updated_at: string | null;
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
    content_policy: "context" | "summary";
}

export interface SearchIndexMatch {
    source_key: string;
    kind: string;
    object_id: string;
    project_id: string | null;
    revision: string;
    title: string;
    updated_at: string | null;
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
    score: number;
    snippet: string;
    highlights: Array<[number, number]>;
    locator: {
        field: SearchHitField;
        offset: number;
        length: number;
        text: string;
    };
}

export interface SearchIndexPort {
    sources(): SearchIndexSourceRecord[];
    source(sourceKey: string): SearchIndexSourceRecord | null;
    saveSource(record: SearchIndexSourceRecord): void;
    removeSource(sourceKey: string): number;
    removeProject(projectId: string): number;
    revisions(sourceKey: string): Map<string, string>;
    count(sourceKey: string): number;
    upsert(documents: readonly SearchIndexDocument[]): void;
    remove(sourceKey: string, keys: readonly {
        kind: string;
        object_id: string;
    }[]): void;
    document(sourceKey: string, kind: string, objectId: string): SearchIndexDocument | null;
    search(query: SearchIndexQuery): {
        matches: SearchIndexMatch[];
        total: number;
    };
    clear(): number;
    close(): void;
}

export interface SearchIndexQuery {
    query: string;
    sources: readonly {
        source_key: string;
        readable_kinds: readonly string[];
    }[];
    kinds?: readonly string[];
    offset: number;
    limit: number;
}

export interface SearchIndexSourceRecord {
    source_key: string;
    project_id: string | null;
    provider_id: string;
    capability_id: string;
    version: number;
    plugin_id: string;
    title: string;
    collection_revision: string | null;
    state: "ready" | "indexing" | "failed";
    error: string | null;
    synced_at: number | null;
    checked_at: number | null;
}

export interface SearchOpenRequest {
    hit_id: string;
}

export type SearchOpenResponse = {
    state: "ok";
    hit_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    open: SearchOpenTarget | null;
    title: string;
    revision: string;
} | {
    state: "missing";
    hit_id: string;
    reason: string;
} | {
    state: "unavailable";
    hit_id: string;
    reason: string;
};

export interface SearchQueryRequest {
    query: string;
    scope?: SearchScope;
    kinds?: string[];
    plugins?: string[];
    cursor?: string | null;
    limit?: number;
}

export interface SearchQueryResponse {
    status: SearchQueryStatus;
    hits: SearchHit[];
    next_cursor: string | null;
    sources: SearchSourceStatus[];
}

export type SearchQueryStatus = "complete" | "partial" | "indexing" | "empty_scope";

export interface SearchRebuildRequest {
    scope?: SearchScope;
}

export interface SearchRebuildResponse {
    cleared: number;
    sources: SearchSourceStatus[];
}

export type SearchScope = "project" | "personal" | "all";

export type SearchSourceState = "ready" | "indexing" | "stale" | "failed" | "unavailable" | "disabled";

export interface SearchSourceStatus {
    plugin_id: string;
    title: string;
    scope: "project" | "personal";
    state: SearchSourceState;
    reason: string | null;
    indexed_at: string | null;
    entries: number;
}

export interface SearchStatusResponse {
    sources: SearchSourceStatus[];
}

export declare function prepareSearchFragmentOffers(input: FragmentOffersInput): FragmentActionOffer[];

export declare const searchActions: {
    fragmentOffers: ActionDefinition<FragmentOffersInput, {
        offers: FragmentActionOffer[];
    }>;
    query: ActionDefinition<SearchQueryRequest, SearchQueryResponse>;
    open: ActionDefinition<SearchOpenRequest, SearchOpenResponse>;
    status: ActionDefinition<{
        scope?: SearchScope;
    }, SearchStatusResponse>;
    rebuild: ActionDefinition<SearchRebuildRequest, SearchRebuildResponse>;
};

export declare function searchSourceKey(input: {
    project_id: string | null;
    provider_id: string;
    capability_id: string;
    version: number;
}): string;
